name: Walking
benefit: A daily 30-minute walk can lower blood pressure by a few points.

name: Brisk walking
benefit: Walking fast enough to breathe harder helps your body use insulin better.

name: Hiking
benefit: Hills make your heart work harder. Bring water so you don't get dehydrated.

name: Running
benefit: Running strengthens your heart and blood vessels, including the ones that feed your kidneys.

name: Jogging
benefit: An easy jog is a good step up from walking.

name: Cycling
benefit: Cycling builds leg muscle, which helps control blood sugar, and it's easy on your knees.

name: Stationary bike
benefit: Good for steady cardio no matter the weather.

name: Swimming
benefit: Works the whole body without stressing your joints.

name: Elliptical
benefit: Steady cardio that's gentle on the joints.

name: Rowing machine
benefit: Uses your legs, back and arms at once.

name: Stair climbing
benefit: Short bursts on the stairs raise your heart rate quickly.

name: Jump rope
benefit: Very intense, so even 10 minutes counts for a lot.

name: HIIT workout
benefit: Short, hard intervals improve fitness in less time.

name: Dancing
benefit: Gets your heart rate up and is easy to keep doing because it's fun.

name: Zumba or dance class
benefit: A class schedule makes it easier to stay consistent.

name: Weight training
benefit: Muscle uses blood sugar, so strength work twice a week helps prevent diabetes.

name: Push-ups, squats and planks
benefit: Builds strength at home with no equipment.

name: Pilates
benefit: Strengthens your core and improves posture.

name: Rock climbing
benefit: Builds grip, arm and back strength while keeping your heart rate up.

name: Martial arts
benefit: Combines strength, balance and cardio.

name: Boxing or kickboxing
benefit: A hard full-body workout that also relieves stress.

name: Yoga
benefit: Can lower stress and blood pressure, and works for any fitness level.

name: Stretching
benefit: Keeps you flexible and makes other exercise easier.

name: Tai chi
benefit: Slow movements that improve balance and lower stress.

name: Basketball
benefit: Lots of running and jumping, and playing with others keeps you coming back.

name: Soccer
benefit: Mixes running and sprinting, which is great for heart health.

name: Tennis
benefit: Quick bursts of movement that build fitness.

name: Pickleball
benefit: Easier on the body than tennis, and still good exercise.

name: Badminton
benefit: Fast footwork that raises your heart rate.

name: Volleyball
benefit: A social sport with lots of short movements.

name: Cricket
benefit: Running between wickets and fielding add up over a game.

name: Table tennis
benefit: Light exercise that keeps you moving.

name: Golf (walking)
benefit: Walking the course adds several miles.

name: Skateboarding or skating
benefit: Works your legs and balance.

name: Kayaking or paddleboarding
benefit: Builds upper body strength out on the water.

name: Gardening or yard work
benefit: Everyday movement counts. Moving more and sitting less lowers diabetes risk.

name: Heavy housework
benefit: Cleaning, carrying and scrubbing all add to your activity for the week.

name: Walking the dog
benefit: An easy way to fit walking into every day.

name: Biking to school or work
es: Ir en bici a la escuela o trabajo
benefit: Builds exercise into your commute.
